{{Quote|So, how goes the Rebellion?|Lina Andonais|<ref name="RM" />}}
'''Lina Adonais''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Qonto]] space urchin.

==Biography==
Lina Adonais was a young [[Qonto]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who worked aboard the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']] while touring [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. She was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] sympathizer, and considered joining the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|struggle]]. During one voyage aboard the ''Kuari Princess'', Adonais encountered a group of Alliance agents and saw through their disguises but promised not to reveal their identities.<ref name="RM" />

==Personality and traits==
Adonais was an unusually perceptive Qonto. After confirming the loyalties of the Alliance agents on board the ''Kuari Princess'', she frequently ran into them asking for an update on their mission.<ref name="RM" />

==Equipment==
Adonais carried a [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blaster]].<ref name="CA3">[[Riders of the Maelstrom (adventure)|''Riders of the Maelstrom'']]</ref>
